_comment: Owner-written. Only a layout listed here gets a policy in the generated registry (course-geometry/registry.generated.json, via `npm run course-geometry:registry:generate`). Everything else — facilityId, siteIds, dbCourseIds, acceptedCapabilityTier, holeBindings — comes from the catalog layout (course-geometry/catalog/layouts/<layoutId>.json) and its approved geometry package, joined by the generator. `packages` keys are the exact owner-approved geometry content hashes; `livePilot: true` on a hash is the existing on-course pilot exception (Factory v2 §16.1) and must never be copied to a layout that has not itself earned it.
